faq_questions.answer: Continuing operation during error E01 is not recommended as protection sensors may disable normal heating and mechanical operation.

diagnostic_and_fix_steps: Disconnect electrical mains power and isolate fuel or water supply before servicing.
Inspect wiring harness connections to the Digital Voltage Regulator Board for loose pins or corrosion.
Measure component electrical resistance with a digital multimeter against OEM factory specifications.
Replace defective Digital Voltage Regulator Board (GM88453) and restore power to verify diagnostic clearance.
primary_part_search_query: Kohler GM88453 Digital Voltage Regulator Board

faq_questions.question: Can I clear Kohler error code Under Freq by resetting power?
faq_questions.answer: A power reset will clear the volatile memory, but if the issue with the Digital Voltage Regulator Board persists, error code Under Freq will trigger again on the next operational cycle.

faq_questions.question: Is it safe to operate Kohler equipment while Under Freq is showing?
faq_questions.answer: Continuing operation during error Under Freq is not recommended as protection sensors may disable normal heating and mechanical operation.
